claim: La Table de Maxime hotel has 6 rooms above the restaurant; comfort double €240, superior double €260, breakfast included, address Our 23, 6852 Our.
quote: Comfort double room with shower: €240. Superior double room with shower: €260. Single rooms: €15 less than double rates. Address: Our 23, 6852 Our, Belgium.

claim: La Fabrique du Pré Maho is a passive-house, timber-on-stilts annex 200 m from the restaurant, 2 doubles (€240), 1 suite (€280), 1 duplex sleeping 5 (€440).
quote: Comfort double room (23m²): €240. Double suite room (65m²): €280. Duplex (2-5 people): €440. Situated approximately 200 meters from La Table de Maxime restaurant on the river bank.

claim: Les Jardins de Maxime offers 4 rooms in the hamlet of Beth, 1.5 km from the restaurant, in Maxime Collard's kitchen garden; comfort double €240.
quote: Comfort double room (with shower or bath): €240 for two people. Situated in the hamlet of Beth, approximately 1.5 kilometers from La Table de Maxime restaurant in Our, Belgium.

claim: La Roche des Lutons is a 65 m² suite-studio with kitchenette and rock-built terrace, a few minutes' walk from La Table de Maxime; €280 per night with breakfast.
quote: 65 square meters. Kitchenette for complete autonomy during stays. €280 per night for a double suite room (includes breakfast for two). A quelques minutes à pieds de la Table de Maxime.

claim: Les Terrasses de l'Our (in the village of Our, by the river) has 14 rooms €150–210, sauna €20, half-board packages €250–330; operated by the Rouard family.
quote: 14 contemporary-styled guest rooms. Standard double (shower): €150. Comfort double (shower): €170. Superior double (shower/bathtub): €190. Suite double for 2-4 guests: €210. Rue de Lesse 1, 6852 Our, Belgium. The Rouard family operates this combined hotel-restaurant establishment.

claim: Maxime Collard transferred Les Terrasses de l'Our to the Rouard family on 3 October 2024 after running it for 9 years.
quote: The Rouard family, young restaurateurs from Wanlin (Houyet)… They started their work on October 3, 2024.

claim: La Table de Maxime holds two Michelin stars in the 2026 Belgium guide.
quote: La Table de Maxime is a Two-Star Michelin Guide restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Belgium.

claim: Michelin 2026: La Table de Maxime retains its 2 stars among Luxembourg-province restaurants.
quote: Michelin 2026 : La Table de Maxime garde ses 2 étoiles.

claim: Le Moulin de Daverdisse is a 4-star family-run hotel in a former watermill with 24 rooms, indoor pool, sauna and hammam, ~11 km from Our.
quote: Le Moulin de Daverdisse is a 4-star hotel… Set in a former watermill beside the river… 24 rooms… 4-star accommodations with an indoor pool, sauna and hammam.

claim: Hotel Le Fournil in the book village of Redu has 11 rooms, free Nespresso machines, EV charging, breakfast included; rates from ~€102.
quote: 11 elegant rooms in two buildings in the center of the village… free Nespresso coffee machine… 2 E.V. charging stations… The prices at the hotel start from €102.

claim: Auberge la Hutte Lurette is a 3-star inn in Paliseul village with 12 rooms, restaurant, average rate ~$148; Tripadvisor 4.1 stars.
quote: The 3-star hotel has a garden, terrace, a restaurant and bar… 12 rooms… average rate is around $148 per night.

claim: Le Maissin 1876 is a 5/5-rated B&B in Maissin (≈4 km from Paliseul) with bistro, themed rooms, run by host Ann.
quote: Bed and Breakfast in the beautiful Ardennes… amazing breakfast in their new veranda… Bistro where guests can enjoy dinner prepared with local products.

claim: Le Gastronome in Paliseul village has 8 rooms (some with bathtub-and-living-room suites); dinner-and-stay packages from €290 for two.
quote: 8 comfortable rooms with a sleek and colorful design… Room packages start from 290€ for two, including a menu, night stay, and breakfast.

claim: Le Passage B&B is a 3-room guesthouse in a turn-of-the-20th-century house in Paliseul, rated 5/5 on Tripadvisor.
quote: 3 fully equipped rooms… rated 5 of 5 at Tripadvisor… The house dates from beginning 20th century.

claim: Tripadvisor's Paliseul ranking puts La Table de Maxime at #1 Best Value, Le Gastronome #2, EnjoyHotel Maison des Ardennes #3, Auberge la Hutte Lurette #4.
quote: Le Maissin 1876 - 5.0 stars #8 Best Value. La Table de Maxime - 4.6 stars #1 Best Value. Le Gastronome 4.9 stars #2 Best Value.

claim: Maxime Collard operates a portfolio of four lodgings in and around the hamlet of Our: La Table de Maxime, La Fabrique du Pré Maho, La Roche des Lutons, Les Jardins de Maxime.
quote: La Table de Maxime… La Roche des Lutons… Les Jardins de Maxime… La Fabrique du Pré Maho.

claim: Our is a hamlet of roughly 30 granite houses in the Belgian Ardennes; the renovated manor housing the hotel sits next to the river Our.
quote: The hamlet of Our is located in the Belgian Ardennes and has approximately 30 granite houses.

claim: Le Moulin de Daverdisse sits in 6 hectares of forest on the Lesse river and offers bike rental on-site.
quote: Six hectares of unspoilt nature… bike rental is available at Moulin de Daverdisse.
